findings: Three missing public operations added: administrator readiness, voice closure phase and screen profile descriptor.
Cookie required for 79 operations; ten accept anonymous requests, including optional session and idempotent logout.
All public mutations require exact configured Origin; realtime allows omitted Origin and otherwise checks host via websocket.Accept.
Relay 400/413/415/503 and screen-metrics 400 are intentionally empty; relay 401/429 use JSON Error.
Client update 400/503/500 use flat error string; shared Error allows compact code-only handler details.
Private /metrics and LiveKit hooks remain excluded from client paths.
limitations: Parameter extraction covers explicit handler constructors and local helper request reads, with documented cross-cutting transport/diagnostic headers.
Issue remains open for owner acceptance; this record does not close a release or physical gate.
